# Ogify

> Ogify is a developer API for website screenshots, HTML-to-image rendering, URL/HTML-to-PDF generation, Open Graph images, branded social cards, page metadata extraction, rendered-content extraction, reusable templates, and hosted render assets.

Canonical website: https://ogify.online
API base URL: https://api.ogify.online

## Start here
- [Website](https://ogify.online/): Product overview and live rendering demo.
- [Quickstart](https://ogify.online/docs/quickstart): Create an API key and make your first render request.
- [API documentation](https://ogify.online/docs): API guides and endpoint reference.
- [Pricing](https://ogify.online/pricing): Plans and monthly render quotas.
- [Examples](https://ogify.online/examples): Copyable cURL and integration examples.
- [Template gallery](https://ogify.online/docs/templates): Built-in social-card templates and reusable HTML templates.
- [JavaScript SDK and CLI](https://ogify.online/docs/sdk): TypeScript SDK and command-line workflows.

## Main capabilities
- [Open Graph image API](https://ogify.online/open-graph-image-api): Generate share images from structured content.
- [Dynamic OG images](https://ogify.online/dynamic-og-images): Create content-driven social images during publishing or deployment.
- [Next.js OG images](https://ogify.online/nextjs-og-images): Integrate rendering with Next.js metadata and server-side code.
- [Website screenshot API](https://ogify.online/website-screenshot-api): Capture public URLs as images.
- [Social preview image generator](https://ogify.online/social-preview-image-generator): Generate branded social cards and screenshot composites.
- [Cloudflare screenshot API](https://ogify.online/cloudflare-screenshot-api): Learn about the hosted browser-rendering API.

## API endpoints
- `POST /v1/render/url` — website screenshots.
- `POST /v1/render/html` — HTML and CSS to image.
- `POST /v1/render/pdf` — URL or HTML to PDF.
- `POST /v1/render/template` — render a built-in or reusable template.
- `POST /v1/render/social` — extract page metadata and generate a branded social card.
- `POST /v1/render/composite` — capture a website and place it inside a branded card.
- `POST /v1/render/batch` — run multiple rendering operations.
- `POST /v1/extract/metadata` — extract Open Graph and page metadata.
- `POST /v1/extract/content` — extract rendered content and resolved links.

## Integration guidance
- API keys must remain server-side and must not be placed in public browser code.
- Start with the quickstart before using endpoint-specific reference pages.
- Use the official docs for current request fields, authentication, limits, and response schemas.
